messages:
ana: Quick update — we're opening a small dedicated A40s micro-pool in Lima (LIM) pocket-zone next week. Rolling window starts Mon 2025-12-15 00:00 UTC. Intended for low-latency, low-memory inference (batch size small).

lee: Nice. Is this a canary or full launch?

ana: It's staged: 24h internal canary for infra + SE accounts, then soft-open to customers in waves over 7 days. We'll keep preemptible reservations disabled for the first 2 weeks while we watch stability.

samir: What's the reservation cap per org? Planning for fairshare.

ana: Reservation caps: 3 active pocket reservations per org by default. If you need >3, request via #capacity-requests and include workload profile. Fairshare policy now weights "pocket" reservations at 0.6 during peak hours to reduce noisy neighbor risk.

maria: Billing / rate question for sales decks?

ana: Billing: same per-hour dedicated SKU as other A40s micro-pools but prorated to 1-minute granularity. Early access promo: first 72h free credit for qualifying customers (GTM will get the eligibility list). Tagging requirement: set `env:production` and `zone_tag:pocket-lim` on reservations so billing and metrics pipeline pick them up.

lee: Any autoscale/overflow behavior? If pocket fills, do requests fail or route to fallback region?

ana: Smart routing rules will attempt region fallback to `sa-east-1` (SCL) for compatible model variants, then to `eu-west-1` if SCL unavailable. Fallback applies only to requests with `fallback_allowed: true` in the route policy. If fallback not allowed, requests will queue up to 30s then return capacity error.

samir: Ops / monitoring to watch?

ana: Dashboards: added LIM A40s micro-pool tile to Console -> Dedicated -> Pools. Key metrics: utilization, avg queue time, OOMs, preempt events. Alert thresholds: util > 85% for 10m, queue > 30s for 5m, OOM rate > 0.5% per 1h.

ops-bot: Runbook link: https://intranet.redwood.ai/runbooks/lima-pocket-a40s (ops checklist, rollback steps, CLI migration snippet).

lee: Migration snippet?

ana: Example CLI to create reservation: `redwood reservations create --pool pocket-lim-a40s --size 2 --duration 30d --tags env=production,zone_tag=pocket-lim`

maria: Should we proactively contact affected customers on dedicated waitlists?

ana: Yes — GTM will get a CSV of eligible accounts. We'll email with migration instructions and mention the 72h promo credit.

samir: Any policy change to fairshare docs we should update?

ana: Yup — updated policy: "Pocket reservations have a weight factor of 0.6 in peak fairness windows (12:00-00:00 UTC)". Docs updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/fairshare#pocket-weighting

lee: Noted. I'll add the LIM pool to the outage playbook and add a canary alert.

ana: Thanks — if you see anything odd during canary ping @ana and @lee. We'll post a short status update after internal canary (T+24h). :rocket: 

maria: Thx — will prep GTM copy and sales notes.

samir: good to go from ops side. :thumbsup:

lee: +1 from infra.

ana: Launch timeline summary: 2025-12-15 00:00 UTC internal canary -> 2025-12-16 soft-open wave1 -> 2025-12-21 full soft-open. Will post a follow-up thread with any changes.

ops-bot: Scheduled job: Canary allocation script will run at 2025-12-15T00:05:00Z. Notification will be sent to #oncall and #capacity-ops.
